Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Recycling Facility")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Maps.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Three white chasing arrows on a black tile, as described.

cards.name: Rest Area
cards.summary: Symbol 'Rest Area' from Illustrator's Maps symbol library: a solid red picnic table seen from the side, with a flat top bar, A-shaped legs and a long bench bar, and no tile. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 14 x 11 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a labelled map key: the symbol has no text; add the label with the Type tool
colour coding that must match your map key: the colours are fixed in the artwork; break the link and recolour to suit
telling it from Picnic Area: the glyph is the same table, here red with no black tile
large-format use at natural size: it is a map marker only about 14 x 11 pt; scale it up for icons, posters or signs
